recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed unless FHIR-I reopens the normative contained-resource metadata policy.
issue_request: FHIR-16622 was Published/Persuasive for FHIR-core DomainResource and requested that contained-resource security labels be disallowed with an invariant while contained-resource tags remain generally allowed.
initial_application: The request was applied by git-svn commit 1e1877180a069320e60af6aaff497ec66b8a09d3 (GF#16622 / svn r13892), which added the DomainResource.contained comment and dom-5 invariant to the spreadsheet source. Commit 33b409a4b6d544598262f2f074ebb4b6dc466157 later carried the rule into source/domainresource/structuredefinition-DomainResource.xml during the source rework.
additional_context: DomainResource is active in source/fhir.ini. Current source/domainresource/structuredefinition-DomainResource.xml contains dom-5 with expression contained.meta.security.empty() and says contained resources may have profiles and tags but SHALL NOT have security labels; source/references.html gives the same guidance. Later FHIR-50103 directly requested weakening the contained-resource meta.security SHALL NOT rule and was resolved Not Persuasive/No Change, with FHIR-I minutes confirming that contained resources inherit the containing resource's security.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current build source already implements the FHIR-16622 resolution and later work-group evidence supports preserving it.

related_jiras.note: Later Resolved - No Change issue rejected weakening the contained-resource meta.security prohibition and confirms the current FHIR-16622 behavior remains intentional.
